pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/43854

Problem Summary:
1. This [issue](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/35803) support canceling DDL statements with KILL（related PR:#35923）.
---**The original PR that supported this didn't seem to say cancel DDL on "kill TiDB"**

2. But after these PRs, when we do `kill TiDB`, this TiDB's DDLs **may be** canceled(In some cases it can't be cancelled).
--- **Cancel DDL is not fully supported in the case of "kill TiDB".**

3. This [issue](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/39751) need do "Pause user DDL when upgrading TiDB", but these DDLs may be canceled by `kill TiDB`. So we consider `kill TiDB` can not cancel DDL.

4. We'll deal with this in detail when we distinguish between asynchronous and synchronous DDLs.

### What is changed and how it works?
If don't we kill TiDB can't cancel DDLs.

We'll deal with this in detail when we distinguish between asynchronous and synchronous DDLs.
